summary: CyTube is a MySQL+Redis-backed self-hosted synchronized video-watching and chat server: registered users own channels with a synchronized playlist, chat, emotes, filters, polls, bans and moderation ranks; per-channel state persists as JSON rows in channel_data plus direct tables (users, channels, channel_ranks, channel_bans, channel_libraries, user_playlists, aliases, global_bans, password_reset, media_metadata_cache, user_deletion_requests, banned_channels, meta).
